answer: Peers track reputation along a single thread of signed attestations, and any duplicate vertex in the identity graph forfeits the full bond. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified hardware root, so spawning fake identities costs real capital per node. Attackers must burn timber-like reserves for every clone, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
